checks.check: every .ddsc closes its own container (size_header + size_body == file length)
every .ddsc mip chain is accounted for by exactly one block size, and the ranges tile the payload to EOF
the format id -> block size map is a function (one block size per format) across the fleet
the constant at +40 is the same on every .ddsc
the .ddsc header tail 0x2C..0x80 is zero on the FULL files and non-zero on the PARTIAL ones (the grade follows the bytes, not the file name)
every .pfxc holds a Havok packfile that jc3hkx parses at the located offset
every .pfxc packfile ends before the file end and its trailing blob is recorded per file
the 4 .pfxc share the wrapper and the packfile layout (u32 triple, packfile offset, packfile length, trailing length)
